description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter' that enhances command objects by setting headers related to acknowledgment and response requirements, unless they are explicitly defined. It provides mechanisms for default header configuration, especially for commands requiring implicit acknowledgments, and includes logic for handling specific header states like 'response-required' and 'requested-acks'.

classes.name: AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter
classes.description: An abstract class for setting acknowledgment-related headers on command objects unless they are already defined. It is parameterized with a command type that implements 'WithDittoHeaders', and provides methods to determine the applicability of setting headers, handle specific header states, and ensure default acknowledgment and response configurations.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Implements the UnaryOperator interface to conditionally set default headers on the command object if applicable.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a command is eligible for header enhancement.

methods.name: getMatchedClass
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the class type of the command handled by this setter.

methods.name: isLiveChannelCommand
methods.description: Checks if the command was sent via the 'live' channel based on its headers.

methods.name: isBindResponseRequiredToAddingRemovingImplicitLabel
methods.description: Abstract method indicating if response-required should be linked to adding/removing the implicit acknowledgement label.

methods.name: setDefaultDittoHeaders
methods.description: Core method that applies default acknowledgment and response headers based on current header states and conditions.

methods.name: implicitAcksRequested
methods.description: Determines and sets whether implicit acknowledgments are requested based on headers and command state.

methods.name: explicitRequestedAcksFiltered
methods.description: Filters out negated acknowledgment labels from explicitly requested acknowledgments.

methods.name: responseRequiredSet
methods.description: Sets or modifies the 'response-required' header based on timeout and other header states.
